sampling.target_rule: floor(mean sub-training class count), capped at 15x each original class
sampling.sampler_policy: SMOTE-NC when categorical features exist; SMOTE for purely numeric data
sampling.categorical_interpolation: categorical values are never linearly interpolated

class_weights.normalization: per-variant sample weights normalized to mean 1
class_weights.proposed_correction: recompute inverse-frequency weights from the post-SMOTE/Tomek class distribution to avoid duplicate compensation
